Micargi Jakster 20” BMX Bike – Youth Freestyle Bicycle
The Micargi Jakster 20” BMX Bike is built for young riders who want style, durability, and everyday fun. Designed with a sturdy steel frame and classic BMX geometry, the Jakster is perfect for neighborhood rides and parks cruising.
Available in Black or Red, this bike features bold graphics and eye-catching colored rims that make it stand out while delivering a smooth, confident ride.
Key Features
20” Wheels – Ideal for kids and youth riders
Durable Steel Frame & Fork – Built to handle everyday riding
Single-Speed Drivetrain – Simple, low-maintenance design
Front U Hand Brake – Reliable stopping power
BMX-Style Handlebars – Upright control and comfort
Padded BMX Saddle – Comfortable for longer rides
Color-Matched Rims – Sporty, eye-catching look
Recommended For
Youth riders learning BMX basics
Casual riding, cruising, and neighborhood fun
Kids ready to size up from smaller bikes
The Micargi Jakster combines classic BMX style, dependable construction, and kid-approved design, making it a great choice for parents and young riders alike.
